details.nl: Negozi a Bergamo
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION stores; FILTER CASE WHERE .city = 'Bergamo' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti con prezzo maggiore di 50
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Prodotti; FILTER CASE WHERE .price > 50 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel con rating 5
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE .rating = 5 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Utenti con email
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION users; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT .email = '' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Documenti senza note
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION myCollection; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT .notes KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel a Milano con rating superiore a 4 e prezzo inferiore a 200
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE .city = 'Milano' AND .rating > 4 AND .price < 200 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Ristoranti a Roma o Firenze
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Restaurants; FILTER CASE WHERE (.city = 'Roma' OR .city = 'Firenze') KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti con prezzo tra 100 e 500 euro
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION products; FILTER CASE WHERE .price IN_RANGE [ 100 , 500 ] KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Appartamenti con superficie tra 50 e 100 metri quadri
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION apartments; FILTER CASE WHERE .area IN_RANGE [ 50 , 100 ] KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Ordini dove il campo note è null
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION ordini; FILTER CASE WHERE .note IS NULL KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Clienti dove descrizione non è null
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Clienti; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT (.descrizione = NULL) KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti senza email e senza telefono
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION products; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT .email AND NOT .phone KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel a Milano o Roma con rating maggiore di 4 e prezzo minore di 300
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE (.city = 'Milano' OR .city = 'Roma') AND .rating > 4 AND .price < 300 KEEP OTHERS;
